description: This file contains the implementation of an AWS Token class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to manage AWS security tokens, including creation, serialization, deserialization, and expiration checking.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: A basic implementation of the AWS Token interface that manages security tokens and their expiration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Token instance with a specified token string and optional expiration timestamp.

methods.name: __set_state
methods.description: Creates a new Token instance from an array of state properties.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Returns the expiration timestamp of the token.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the token has expired based on current time.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the token data as an associative array.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the token object into a JSON string.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Reconstructs the object from a serialized JSON string.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Prepares the object data for serialization into an array.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Sets the object's properties from an array of data.
